chunks: And frowned and puckered his brow,

key_terms.بَسَرَ: He puckered or wrinkled his brow/forehead
key_terms.عَبَسَ: He frowned or contracted his face in displeasure or concentration

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'thumma 'abasa wa basara' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the Prophet's (SAWW) natural human reaction to the interruption of the revelation concerning the blind companion, Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum, by the elite Quraysh leaders. It underscores the balance between his divine status and his accessible, compassionate demeanor, serving as a lesson for leaders to prioritize the sincere seeker of knowledge over social prestige.
